name: Limgrave
tagline: Where the Tarnished first see the Erdtree.
story: The Elden Ring is shattered. Its fragments, the Great Runes, were seized by the demigods who now rule the Lands Between, and the Erdtree burns gold above the horizon.
Limgrave is the first land the Tarnished see: windswept fields, ruined forts and the grey walls of Stormveil Castle, where Godrick the Grafted rules with a hoard of stolen limbs.
Called back from death by a grace that few remember, you are one of the Tarnished. Cross the fields, break the guardians that bar the road, and take the Great Rune of the land.
ending: Godrick falls and his Great Rune is yours. The grace of Limgrave burns brighter, and the road to Liurnia opens.

characters.name: Vagabond
characters.backstory: A wandering knight who survived the war without a banner. He trusts his armour more than any god.

characters.name: Samurai
characters.backstory: A swordsman from the Land of Reeds, who came to the Lands Between for glory and stayed for the duel.

characters.name: Astrologer
characters.backstory: A glintstone scholar who reads the stars and trusts what they say about the end.

characters.name: Prophet
characters.backstory: A cast-off priest with an incantation for every wound. Faith keeps them standing.

bosses.name: Tree Sentinel
bosses.title: Golden Guardian of the Road
bosses.lore: A golden knight on a golden steed, set to guard the road since before the Shattering. It attacks everything that is not the Erdtree's.

bosses.name: Margit, the Fell Omen
bosses.title: Foe of the Tarnished
bosses.lore: A hunched omen who exists to turn the Tarnished back. It carries a hammer shaped from a thousand wishes, and daggers of holy light.

bosses.name: Flying Dragon Agheel
bosses.title: Wing of the Fallen Sky
bosses.lore: An ancient dragon nesting in the ruins of Limgrave. It scorches the plains with flame and falls upon the Tarnished from above.

bosses.name: Godrick the Grafted
bosses.title: Shardbearer of Stormveil
bosses.lore: A demigod who grafted the limbs of the fallen onto his own body to feel worthy of his lineage. At last he grafts a dragon's head to his arm.

npcs.name: Melina
npcs.quote: Take my hand. I shall give you what you need to keep going.

npcs.name: Merchant Kalé
npcs.quote: Hee hee. A Tarnished! There's coin in it for the both of us.

npcs.name: Roderika
npcs.quote: I want to help the spirits, not just use them.

npcs.name: Varré
npcs.quote: Well, if it isn't a maidenless Tarnished.
